image_description: A night-time photograph showing a woman holding a small hammerhead shark vertically by its cephalofoil (hammer-head). The shark's ventral side (white belly) faces the camera, while its dorsal side is obscured or facing away. Several people are visible in the background on what appears to be a boat deck.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The subject clearly displays the iconic T-shaped head structure characteristic of hammerhead sharks.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The leading edge of the head is visible and matches the structural description of a hammerhead cephalofoil.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The torso tapers smoothly into the tail, exhibiting the typical fusiform shape of a shark.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The visible ventral side is stark white/light grey, contrasting with the darker grey tones visible on the sides/fins, matching the countershading description.
